items.statement: All three public pair identities are explored with multiple orientations and validated minima.
items.expected: Candidate IDs and per-candidate convergence/minimum evidence are retained for DED2_PC, TEA_PC and BF4_PC, with at least two orientations per named pair documented.

items.statement: The comparison is based on consistent component-energy bookkeeping.
items.expected: Each reported pair energy is traceable to the same E_complex minus E_ion minus E_PC definition and sign convention.
The independently computed ordering places DED2_PC as stronger-binding than TEA_PC, or transparently reports a non-robust/bounded outcome with the tested coverage.

items.statement: An isolated electronic ordering is not equivalent to a complete bulk solvation mechanism.
items.expected: The report limits its inference to the isolated-pair observable and identifies the missing condensed-phase and electrode variables.
